name: acyl-CoA synthetase bubblegum family member 2

function.text: ACSBG2 is the approved symbol for acyl-CoA synthetase bubblegum family member 2. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in arachidonate-CoA ligase activity; fatty acyl-CoA hydrolase activity; fatty acid metabolic process.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Clear cell renal cell carcinoma; Papillary renal cell carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: ACSBG2 encodes acyl-CoA synthetase bubblegum family member 2. Its functions include arachidonate-CoA ligase activity and fatty acyl-CoA hydrolase activity.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ACSBG2 have been reported in papillary renal cell carcinoma and clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
